scripts.test: npm run test:sec && npm run test:fundamentals
scripts.test:sec: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/sec.test.ts tests/sec-analysis.test.ts tests/sec-v3.test.ts tests/sec-report.test.ts tests/sec-pipeline.test.ts tests/sec-workflow.test.ts tests/sec-d1.test.ts tests/sec-api.test.ts tests/sec-config.test.ts tests/sec-public-api.test.ts tests/sec-whitelist.test.ts tests/sec-cron.test.ts tests/sec-operations.test.ts tests/sec-integration.test.ts && tsx --test tests/sec-report-render.test.tsx
scripts.test:fundamentals: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/fundamental-metrics.test.ts tests/yahoo-fundamentals-schema.test.ts tests/yahoo-fundamentals-client.test.ts tests/fundamental-normalization.test.ts tests/fundamentals-schema.test.ts tests/fundamentals-d1.test.ts tests/fundamental-sync.test.ts tests/fundamentals-api.test.ts tests/fundamentals-runtime.test.ts tests/fundamentals-api-route.test.ts tests/fundamental-chart.test.ts tests/fundamental-page-state.test.ts && tsx --test tests/fundamental-chart-render.test.tsx tests/fundamental-charts-render.test.tsx
scripts.db:local:apply: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply site-creator-d1 --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.web:deploy: npm run build && npm run web:prepare && npm run web:check && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --keep-vars
